title: DeepContext: A Context-aware, Cross-platform, and Cross-framework Tool for Performance Profiling and Analysis of Deep Learning Workloads
problem: Existing DL profiling tools fail to bridge the semantic gap between high-level Python/framework operations and low-level GPU execution, making it difficult to identify the root cause of performance bottlenecks across the full software stack. No existing tool provides correlated, context-aware profiling spanning Python, DL frameworks, C/C++ libraries, and GPU kernels simultaneously.
motivation: Performance optimization of DL models requires holistic visibility across heterogeneous software and hardware layers, but current profilers provide only siloed views that leave critical cross-stack bottlenecks hidden.
method: DeepContext uses an interceptor—a monitoring layer that watches operations without modifying them—placed between the deep learning framework and C/C++ libraries to record each operation and match it with GPU performance data and the Python code that triggered it. Without changing the framework code itself, this approach traces high-level operations directly to the GPU instructions that executed them. An automated analyzer then examines these linked traces to identify which layers are causing slowdowns and recommend optimizations.
key_novelty: A framework-agnostic interceptor that automatically links Python operations down through the framework and libraries to GPU execution, exposing exactly where performance bottlenecks occur in the entire software stack.
contributions: Framework-agnostic shim layer enabling cross-stack correlation of DL program context with hardware performance metrics
Automated performance analyzer providing actionable optimization guidance from holistic stack-wide profiling data
Cross-platform and cross-framework support covering mainstream DL frameworks on CPU+GPU architectures with low overhead
Discovery and fixing of previously hidden performance bottlenecks achieving 1.06x to 1.66x speedups on real-world DL applications

metrics.speedup: 1.06x to 1.66x on real-world DL applications after guided optimization
metrics.other: Low profiling overhead (not quantified in abstract)

limitations: Not discussed; profiling overhead magnitude and specific framework/platform coverage details are not quantified in the abstract.
primary_theme: Cross-stack DL performance profiling with context correlation
